repos.name: OpenMC Studio
repos.notes: Runs natively on macOS/Linux and through WSL on Windows. Requires the openmc-mcnp conda environment and nuclear data; SEED does not install those dependencies.

prerequisites.label: Git
prerequisites.fix: Install Git for your operating system and make it available on PATH.

prerequisites.label: WSL with a Linux distribution
prerequisites.fix: Install WSL: open a terminal as administrator and run `wsl --install`.

prerequisites.label: The openmc-mcnp conda environment in WSL
args: source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh 2>/dev/null; conda env list | grep -q openmc-mcnp
prerequisites.fix: Create the environment as described in the OpenMC Studio README (setup folder).

repos.name: Fuel Performance Studio (FEED)
repos.notes: Private repository: sign in to GitHub once on this computer (Git Credential Manager or gh auth login). Thermal fuel-pin calculations only. The solver (OpenFOAM + OFFBEAT) runs in the WSL distro feed-solver on Windows; SEED does not install it. Build it with solver/setup-feed-solver.sh and solver/build-offbeat.sh (see the FEED README).

prerequisites.label: Git
prerequisites.fix: Install Git for your operating system and make it available on PATH.

prerequisites.label: Node.js 24 or newer
prerequisites.fix: Install Node.js 24 or newer from nodejs.org.

prerequisites.label: The feed-solver WSL distribution with OFFBEAT
prerequisites.fix: Create the distro as described in the FEED README (solver folder). Without it FEED can validate cases but not run them.
